instructions: Economics tab — Opening & Conversion Path (Radisson Blu parity). Apply with --replace-slot-prefix economics.opening.step and economics.opening.process separately if needed.

rows.title: Application & Feasibility
rows.body: Qualify urban gateway, resort, or conversion asset with IHG development—market tier, lifestyle F&B capability, and conversion PIP scope before term sheet.

rows.title: Design & Standards
rows.body: Kimpton design narrative and F&B program review—adaptive reuse, neighborhood character, wine hour and restaurant-forward spaces, and IHG design approval before major FF&E commit.

rows.title: Pre-Opening Planning
rows.body: PIP sequencing, OS&E, Opera PMS and IHG Concerto CRS cutover, department-head certification budget, and F&B onboarding aligned to lifestyle service standards.

rows.title: Opening Support
rows.body: IHG opening training, Kimpton service and wine hour execution, design and F&B QA, soft opening, and IHG One Rewards launch coordination.

rows.title: Stabilization
rows.body: Heightened lifestyle QA on design, F&B, and guest experience during ramp; third-party operators run day-to-day while IHG development tracks milestone remediation.

Typical Kimpton path: feasibility on conversion or new-build fit, design and F&B narrative approval with realistic lifestyle PIP, pre-opening IHG systems and certification spend, opening QA on restaurant and guestroom standards, then stabilization. Third-party management is common; IHG development approves design and brand milestones while the operator runs opening.
